title: Shipit fully excised: WEI benchmark migrated to closeout Step 0e
description: wai-shipit.md was deleted but 4 files still referenced it: SKILL-EXAMPLES.md (2 entries), wai-ide-setup.md (session commands), and skill-wai-shipit-benchmark-v1.md.teaching (targeted dead file). The WEI benchmark detection was never migrated when shipit was deprecated — closeout Step 0e was a one-liner stub. Fixed: WEI detection added to closeout Step 0e, shipit references purged from all files, teaching retargeted to closeout.
rationale: Silent regression: benchmark tracking was broken after shipit deprecation. Anyone running closeout on a WEI-enabled project would skip benchmark runs entirely.
